From his early days with Greece in 2014 to dominating the international stage in 2025, Giannis Antetokounmpo's athleticism has ALWAYS been unreal!
We've seen the Greek Freak grow from a young prospect throwing down explosive fast-break dunks to one of the most unstoppable forces in basketball. Every year, the power, speed and explosiveness are on another level!
From the FIBA Basketball World Cup to EuroBasket, relive more than a decade of Giannis' MOST INSANE dunks with the Greek national team!
JOIN THE COMMUNITY
